name: seis-mcp-permission
description: Validate public SEIS Repo MCP entrypoints and deny-by-default permission contracts without starting servers.

interface.shortDescription: Validate public MCP permission boundaries without granting access.
interface.longDescription: Inspects the declared local stdio MCP envelope for every public app-owned SEIS Repo package, checks entrypoint and empty write/network/secret permission contracts, and never starts servers, reads credentials, or grants a capability.
defaultPrompt: Validate the declared public SEIS Repo MCP permission boundary in read-only mode.
Show whether MCP entrypoint and empty write, network, and secret permission contracts remain aligned without enabling anything.
